name: conecta-negocio
description: Store-management platform: sales, inventory and distribution.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w client && tsc -p tsconfig.json
